revision_note: Revision2 retains both original scalar-action hypotheses in exists_bound with include hφ hψ; they are proof-only inputs and are not omitted. Frozen predecessor5 is unchanged. The exact previous three arbitrary-ring Laurent modules are retained. A finite generating family is now derived from Module.Finite on the ORIGINAL positive polynomial chart, and its actual image spans the common Laurent module by polynomial span induction through the specified original semilinear restriction formula. Positive monomial stability of that actual image is derived by mapping X^a, while negative stability of the original infinity image is derived by mapping X^-a under the literal Laurent inversion. Thus callers no longer supply a free basis, a finite overlap generating family or either stability property: they provide their actual two original polynomial modules, the original coefficient-linear chart maps and their exact polynomial scalar laws, and actual localization-spanning statements. Only the positive polynomial module must be finitely generated. The old clearing/max argument gives one bound for all larger twists and the exact original coefficient quotient vanishes. No field, reducedness, domain, PID or freeness assumption. Geometric arbitrary-base-change chart construction, actual localization comparison, finite-family base-change control, nonreduced affine derived acyclicity and represented relative divisor/Picard machinery remain separate; no relative geometric H1 assertion is made. Hosted validation and independent acceptance remain pending; no local Lean compilation.
